text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, with the Tokyo Daishoten looming 
just around the corner—

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"—I'd say this year was truly defined by 
Oguri Cap's incredible performances! What 
kind of run will we see in the Arima 
Kinen—"

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"—On the other hand, it has been announced 
that Tamamo Cross will enter a period of 
rest for a while following the Arima 
Kinen—"

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"—This will mark the third battle between 
Tamamo Cross and Oguri Cap, and 
expectations are high that this Arima 
Kinen will become the match of the 
century—"

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
“—Super Creek, who has rapidly risen to 
prominence, and last year's Junior Class 
champion—how will they make their move—?!”

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"—If Inari One had set her sights on the 
Arima Kinen, things would have been even 
more interesting. We'll just have to look 
forward to next year—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Day after day, the media never runs out of 
things to say about the 'Arima Kinen.' 
It's safe to say excitement is higher this 
year than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Both Oguri and Creek are gettin' a ton of 
attention! They really are something else 
after all...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Seeing them making such a loud splash on a 
different path makes my blood boil—I 
refuse to lose to them!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yes, curiously enough, among the Umamusume 
drawing attention in this year's Arima 
Kinen, many share close ties with Inari 
One—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—Tamamo Cross, a powerhouse who built a 
record so dominant through lightning-sharp 
running that she was hailed as the 
strongest active runner in the country.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek, who has recently risen to 
prominence in dramatic fashion, showing a 
running style that combines both stamina 
and sharp speed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“And the 'Monster' who stood at the center 
of the era in an instant with her 
triumphant charge— Oguri Cap.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap and Super Creek in particular 
spend a lot of time with Inari One outside 
of races; they're rivals, but also dear 
friends.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—I guess this really is what they call 
"fate," huh.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
No, maybe... maybe "destiny" really is a 
thing.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Back when Boss first showed me around 
Tracen Academy, we saw Oguri and Creek 
training side-by-side up close, remember?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Back when Big Sis first showed me 
around Tracen Academy, we saw Oguri and 
Creek training side-by-side up close, 
remember?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Back then, how should I put it—I felt this 
strange, burning sensation welling up from 
those guys.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I didn't really get what it was back then, 
y'know? ...But now, I feel like I kinda 
understand.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
It's gotta be "fate" telling me that one 
day, I'm definitely gonna run in the same 
race as these guys—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
And you probably sensed the "destiny" that 
this race was bound to turn into one hell 
of a crazy festival... right?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Haha! I guess I just blabbered on about 
a bunch of nonsense! Sorry, forget what I 
just said—
choice_data_list: There's no such thing as "I have no idea."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—If Inari One proceeds to the Senior Class 
like this and competes in the Central 
League, Oguri Cap and the others will 
surely stand before her as her greatest 
rivals.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For the one who gave her that final push 
to transfer to the academy to reappear as 
the archrival she must defeat is almost 
like—
choice_data_list: I think so too— it's "fate" and "destiny."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Heheh. Now I really can't wait to run 
against them in the Senior Year.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
However, before that, there's something 
we've gotta take this year...!
choice_data_list:
We're definitely going to win the Tokyo 
Daishoten.

We're definitely going to win the Tokyo 
Daishoten.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! So that we can march into the Senior 
Class carrying the crown of the local 
circuits— let's put on the finishing 
touches!
